Finrival Learn

Learn how markets work

Short, plain-language guides to the ideas behind every Finrival screen, with real examples and no jargon

Free · No sign-up · Updated 14 November 2026

On this page
  1. Start here

Start here

These guides explain the ideas behind every Finrival screen, in plain language and with real examples. Each one takes about five minutes. Read them in order if you are new to markets, or jump to whatever you just saw in the app.

What is a stock?What you actually own when you own a share, and why its price moves every day.
Market cap, explainedWhy a $10 stock can be worth more than a $300 one, and how companies are sized.
How to read a candlestick chartOpen, high, low and close in one shape, and what a run of candles can tell you.
Top Gainers and Top DeclinersWhat the daily lists of biggest movers show, and what they never tell you.

How to use these guides

Every guide ends with a way to try the idea yourself in the Web Terminal or the Finrival app, using real end-of-day prices. If you want to practise a decision, Rival gives you 100,000 fictional Rival Credits, so mistakes cost nothing.

More guides are on the way: trading activity and volume, ETFs, dividends, risk and volatility, the P/E ratio, earnings reports, stocks compared with crypto, and practising without real money.

A note on advice

Finrival Learn is general education. It does not know your situation and is not investment advice. Before making a financial decision, consider speaking to a licensed adviser in your country.
